title: Collision bound for unbiased labels
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $m$ be a positive integer, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$ assign labels to cube points. Suppose each label is attained by exactly a fraction $1/m$ of the cube. Choose $X$ uniformly from the cube and, independently in each coordinate, form $Y$ by keeping $X$'s coordinate with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ and flipping it otherwise, where $0\le\rho\le1$. Then $\Pr[f(X)=f(Y)]\le (1/m)^{(1-\rho)/(1+\rho)}$.
